diffs.diff: chip ID register 0xfa: part 106, datasheet reading 57962
diffs.evidence: Same ID in different units: Pimoroni's driver defines 'static const uint16_t CHIP_ID = 0xE26A;' (57962) and reads it as two bytes, 'CHIP_ID_L = 0xfa,' and 'CHIP_ID_H = 0xfb,', so register 0xFA alone holds the low byte 0x6A = 106 and 0xFB holds 0xE2 = 226, exactly as the model's sim registers have them.
